name: Junior Ranger AI
summary: A mobile-first environmental learning app for children, built as a university group project.
description: A mobile-first environmental learning app aimed at children, currently being pitched for assessment. Leading the mobile UI/UX direction across the group, focused on making environmental concepts approachable for a young audience.

name: IFN580 — Machine Learning
summary: Group coursework covering data preprocessing and machine learning tasks for QUT's IFN580 unit.
description: Coursework for the Machine Learning unit at QUT, worked through with a small group. Assignment 1 covers data preprocessing and core ML tasks, run out of a VS Code + Jupyter setup rather than Anaconda.

name: Beyond All Reason — Modding & Maps
summary: Modding and map creation for the real-time strategy game Beyond All Reason.
description: Ongoing tinkering with modding and map creation tools for Beyond All Reason, an open-source real-time strategy game. A side interest that keeps the games background from the games degree active alongside everything else on the go.

name: Turtle Warriors
summary: Third-person educational game following the life struggles sea turtles face.
description: A third-person educational game that takes the player through the life struggles sea turtles face. Includes minigames exploring the early childhood and adult life of a sea turtle.

name: Necro Ascent
summary: Single-player dungeon crawler using weapon abilities to fight through each floor.
description: A single-player dungeon crawler where the player uses various weapon abilities to defeat AI enemies and push through each floor.
